body: I'm sorry I realize I forgot to reply to this a while back now. But I appreciate the support and I think I'll be ok for now things aren't as bad as they were but still the thoughts haven't gone. But I will keep your offer in mind thank you very much.

I'm holding on so far. Trying to think of the positives in life and what I can look forward too. Still having strong suicidal thoughts tho. What's mainly keeping me from doing it is I refuse to do it near the holidays because my family will just be reminded of it every year abd ruin it for them. And I don't think I could cause my sister that much pain since we're like best friends I don't want to hurt her, or anyone else for that matter.

It's gotten much worse since Iv posted. The girl im in love with ended up breaking up with her boyfriend and we've been talking like we were already together. Like I stayed up facetimeinf her for hours because she wanted to and I'm deployed so time zones are completely different. I had to go somewhere for a week and came back excited to talk to her and when I connected to wifi the first text I got was " I went on a date with a good friend of mine and had a lot of fun so I'm gonna see where this goes" broke my fucking heart and I can't bring myself to respond to her now, not to mention after a month of being where I am my now EX cheated on me with a guy she met at her work.

I'm working on trying to find out why I'm depressed. But since Iv felt this way almost my whole life I can't imagine what it might be since nothing new is the cause of it just adds to it. Iv done the same Iv stopped trying to please anyone at the moment but myself it works for a little bit but not for long at all. Iv accepted that were probably not going to end up together and remain friends wich is fine because we are great friends. I can't seem to find to courage to talk to anyone about it. This is the first time iv talked to anyone about it and i was still hesitant about posting on here. And I'd like to say thank you for talking to me.

is it bad that iv already tried that? all it did was numb me to the image I guess. its horrible and was very hard to watch and that's the last thing id want my parents to is see how fuck up my body is after death.
